title: Gate dependent work on a versioned contract
statement: As an architect coordinating parallel work, I can define a versioned provider-consumer contract and record its lifecycle so dependent work opens only against the agreed revision.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A contract revision identifies its provider and consumer, kind, statement, and observable acceptance checks.
A contract dependency is satisfied only when its named revision remains current and has one fulfilled lifecycle head; another revision does not satisfy it.
A supported public plan command appends proposed, accepted, fulfilled, violated, or waived contract state with its parent heads and exposes the event through work-event queries.
